# Kaichen Power - Diesel Generator Sets Manufacturer

> Jiangsu Kaichen Power Equipment Co., Ltd. is a professional diesel generator sets manufacturer based in Yangzhou, China. We design and produce diesel generator sets ranging from 20 kVA to 3000 kVA, including silent type, open type, containerized and trailer-mounted generators. We partner with world-class engine brands including Cummins, Weichai, Yuchai, SDEC, Perkins, Volvo, Doosan, Mitsubishi, Scania and Shangchai, paired with high-quality alternators from Stamford, Leroy Somer and Mecc Alte.

## Engine Brands
- [Cummins Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/category/cummins/) - 20kW to 800kW generators powered by Cummins engines (including Dongfeng Cummins and Chongqing Cummins)
- [Weichai Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/category/weichai/) - 20kW to 500kW generators powered by Weichai engines
- [Yuchai Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/category/yuchai/) - 50kW to 600kW generators powered by Yuchai engines
- [SDEC Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/category/sdec/) - 50kW to 500kW generators powered by SDEC engines
- [Perkins Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/category/perkins/) - 50kW to 1000kW generators powered by Perkins engines
- [Volvo Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/category/volvo/) - 100kW to 600kW generators powered by Volvo Penta engines
- [Doosan Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/category/doosan/) - 200kW to 800kW generators powered by Doosan engines
- [Mitsubishi Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/category/mitsubishi/) - 200kW to 1500kW generators powered by Mitsubishi engines
- [Scania Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/category/scania/) - 200kW to 700kW generators powered by Scania engines
- [Shangchai Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/category/shangchai/) - 100kW to 600kW generators powered by Shangchai engines

## Generator Types
- [Silent Type Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/) - Soundproof canopy generators with 65-75 dB(A) noise level, ideal for offices, hospitals and residential areas
- [Open Type Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/) - Open frame generators for machine rooms with existing acoustic treatment
- [Containerized Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/) - 20ft and 40ft containerized generator solutions for outdoor and remote sites
- [Mobile Trailer Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/) - Trailer-mounted generators for construction sites and mobile power applications
- [High Voltage Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/) - 6.3kV to 11kV generators for industrial and utility applications
- [Parallel Operation Systems](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/) - Multi-generator parallel systems for large power demands

## Applications
- [Industrial Power Solutions](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/solutions/industrial/) - Backup and prime power for factories and industrial facilities
- [Commercial Building Power](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/solutions/commercial/) - Reliable standby power for hotels, hospitals and commercial buildings
- [Construction Site Power](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/solutions/construction/) - Mobile power solutions for construction sites
- [Telecom Power Solutions](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/solutions/telecom/) - 24/7 reliable power for telecom base stations
- [Data Center Power](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/solutions/) - N+1 redundant power systems for data centers
- [Mining & Oilfield Power](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/solutions/) - Heavy-duty generators for mining and oilfield operations

## Specifications
- Power range: 20 kVA - 3000 kVA
- Engine brands: Cummins, Weichai, Yuchai, SDEC, Perkins, Volvo, Doosan, Mitsubishi, Scania, Shangchai
- Alternator brands: Stamford, Leroy Somer, Mecc Alte, Marathon
- Voltage: 220V single phase - 11kV three phase
- Frequency: 50 Hz / 60 Hz
- Noise level: 65-75 dB(A) at 7 meters (silent type)
- Control system: DeepSea, SmartGen, ComAp automatic controller with 4G remote monitoring
- Certification: CE, ISO 9001, ISO 14001
- Warranty: 1 year or 1,000 hours (extendable to 2 years)
- Lead time: 7-15 days (standard), 25-45 days (custom)
- Export markets: Southeast Asia, Middle East, Africa, South America, Eastern Europe, Central Asia
